## Strive, Inc. (ASST) `[Internet & Platforms]`
- Strive disclosed the acquisition of **1,355 BTC for approximately $107.7 million**, at an average price of about **$79,475 per bitcoin**; the purchase was reported on **September 23, 2026**. (Stocktwits)
- The purchase exceeded Strategy’s reported acquisition of **950 BTC for approximately $75.7 million**, providing the primary crypto-treasury sector catalyst during the window. (Yahoo Finance)
- B. Riley raised its price target from **$26 to $33** and maintained a **Buy** rating on **September 22, 2026**. (B. Riley note)

- UBS maintained a **Neutral** rating and raised its price target from **$8 to $9** on September 22, 2026. (UBS note)
- UBS raised its fiscal 2027, 2028, and 2029 revenue estimates to **$449 million, $512 million, and $630 million**, respectively, from **$438 million, $490 million, and $603 million**. (UBS note)
- ChargePoint Chief Financial Officer Mansi Khetani filed a sale of **4,931 shares at a weighted-average price of $9.86**, valued at **$48,619**, on September 22, 2026; the sale covered tax withholding connected with restricted-stock-unit vesting. (SEC filing)
- ChargePoint General Counsel Eric Batill filed a sale of **4,302 shares at $9.86**, valued at **$42,417**, for the same tax-withholding purpose. (SEC filing)
- No new company-specific operating announcement was identified in the available September 23, 2026 coverage. (MarketBeat)
